evidence: Authored for this product: task/instruction.md is a first-person brief specific to a code playground ("I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source"); task.toml has no CHANGE_ME residue (name "turing/colderwater-playground-devtools", arena_slice "custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history", category "programming" as NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:82 prescribes). A case-insensitive grep of the whole frozen task for patchpad|incident|gridforge|boardloom|bazaarbridge|hireops|ridgeline|pellmoor|threadline|workbook|sign in as returned no hits, and the product name is spelled Colderwater consistently in app_context.md:3, all five prompt.md files, task.toml and the golden. Not a nouns-swapped clone: the nearest sibling by concept is projects/patchpad-editor-v3 (custom incident-report editor). Roughly a third of the 42 Functional criteria have a PatchPad analogue (custom surface, grapheme editing, mouse selection, block indent, multi-caret typing/delete, find/replace, replace-all, save/restart, stale save, history restore), and one is visibly derived from it: cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic (functional/judge.toml:97-103, "Type the five characters MULTI ... three different lines ... One Undo must remove all fifteen inserted characters") mirrors PatchPad's multi_caret_full_typing_single_undo ("Type exactly MULTI using five normal sequential key presses"). But the flows and criteria are not the same set with renamed entities: PatchPad is one seeded document (seed_document_integrity, manifest_documents_runtime_routes, direct_api_save_rejection_nonmutation_matrix, word navigation, selection autoscroll, restart seed idempotence) whereas Colderwater has an empty seed, a many-snippet shared library and about 27 Functional criteria with no sibling counterpart: JS/HTML token colouring, Format document with undo and error handling, Run into an isolated preview, HTML mode, error message with line number, Promise rejection, console ordering, fresh document per run, five-second budget, last-good recovery, Stop, superseding run, preview isolation, dynamic-evaluation refusal, live library refresh and newer-revision notice (functional/judge.toml:169-399). The derived criterion uses its own fixture wording and requires both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click, matching ui.md:9, where PatchPad accepts either. No other project under projects/ is a code playground or execution sandbox (listing checked). Domain plan: no standalone suite domain-plan document exists in the workspace, so fit was judged from the slug suffix -devtools, task.toml provenance "Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task." and the authoring context's treatment of Colderwater as an assigned brief; this is an inference, not a check against a plan document. Runtime evidence in the index is not relevant to this row; nothing here asserts a judge, Oracle or portal result.
